remarks: Newly remodeled kitchen with quartz countertop, stainless steel appliances and a gas range with a griddle for cooking pancakes and/or maybe grilling bacon and eggs. The cozy balcony is perfect for your favorite beverage to start and end your day. Located at Fountain Terrace across from the Tully Center, this one bedroom condo is waiting for you! There is plenty of storage space in the unit as well as a private storage unit in the building just for you. Workout at the gym after putting in you laundry which is located in the basement. During the Summer, relax by the swimming pool and swim a few laps. The location is so close to the vibrant city life of Downtown Stamford's restaurants, pubs, movies, shopping and cultural events. Included in your HOA is heat/hot water, basic cable and 1 parking space. To complete this package there is a 24 hour security gate, and visitor parking. What more can you ask for?
